dict.string: OmniGart reads heart rate, HRV, sleep, workouts, active and resting energy, heart-rate recovery, workout effort, mindful minutes when you enable them, body mass, and related wellness samples from Apple Health so it can show readiness, recovery, and training estimates on your device. If a sample is later removed from Apple Health, OmniGart keeps your on-device copy. Health data stays on your devices and is never used for advertising or sold to third parties.

OmniGart writes strength, yoga, Pilates, Zone 2, and indoor treadmill runs — with duration, active and resting energy, heart rate, distance from a linked treadmill when available, segments, and recovery or effort scores when available — plus optional mindful minutes for yoga and wellness metrics you choose to share into Apple Health so they appear in the Fitness app. Writes are append-only: OmniGart never deletes or rewrites Apple Health data, including workouts it created; later edits stay in OmniGart. Nothing is sent to advertisers or unrelated third parties.

OmniGart uses Bluetooth to connect to treadmills and heart-rate accessories you choose, so live speed, incline, and distance can appear in Treadmill run and improve on-device wellness estimates. You can keep using the app without connecting any accessory.
OmniGart uses the camera only when you scan a food barcode to look up nutrition information. You can log food manually if you prefer not to allow camera access.
OmniGart can send reminders for workouts, hydration, and morning wellness check-ins you opt into. You can use the app fully with notifications turned off.
